quote: A person shall not drive a motor vehicle at such a slow speed as to impede the normal and reasonable movement of traffic except when reduced speed is necessary for safe operation or in compliance with law.

activation.condition: A person drives a motor vehicle at a slow speed that may impede normal and reasonable traffic movement.

obligation.description: Do not drive at a slow speed that impedes normal and reasonable movement of traffic, subject to the stated exceptions.

exceptions.trigger: Reduced speed is necessary for safe operation.
exceptions.effect: The slow-speed prohibition has the stated safety exception.
exceptions.source_clause: except when reduced speed is necessary for safe operation

exceptions.trigger: Reduced speed is in compliance with law.
exceptions.effect: The slow-speed prohibition has the stated compliance exception.

timing.description: Observe synchronized subject and following traffic motion over the complete original interval; the statute gives no numeric duration.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: normal and reasonable movement of traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: No statutory numeric traffic-speed, queue-size, or duration cutoff.
Physical obstruction and reduced speed require source-backed necessity review.
Physical speed-limit device does not by itself establish governing legal authority.
